utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Much appreciated, Ira. I’ll stick to the plan and keep things simple here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — if I hear anything useful, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — what’s the repair drive need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring any tools, spare parts, or tape you can spare. If you’ve got an hour, that helps too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can bring some tape and a few tools, and I can spare about an hour.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure the repair drive is still happening, Pia?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d want to double-check the timing and where they’re collecting things first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, let’s double-check it before we say anything for sure.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive — I’m in for it, I just need the details again. When and where should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re meeting Saturday morning at the community shed by Maple Street. Just bring gloves if you have them, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — Saturday morning at the community shed by Maple Street. I’ll bring gloves and be there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details before I say more?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That should work—I can help make sure it fits around the school schedule. Once Dane’s details come in, I’ll help line everything up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I’ll wait for Dane’s details before I commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we still need a few hands to sort tools and load the donations. If you’re free, that’d help a ton.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m free — I can help sort tools and load the donations.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Sam — could you bring your drill and a few screwdrivers? If you’ve got an extra hand, we can sort donations and fix the wobbly shelves.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my drill and screwdrivers, and I can help sort donations and fix the shelves too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked any repair-drive spots yet, but I can keep an eye on where everything’s being dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be great—thank you. I’ll coordinate with the school schedule and let you know where to send any new drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — send me the locations and I’ll keep track of the drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is getting a really good turnout so far—people have been bringing tools, cash, and plenty of coffee. If you’re free, it’d be a great time to swing by and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, that sounds great — I’ll swing by and see what they still need. I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful—thank you! I’ll let you know if I hear they need anything specific later today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—what’s the repair drive need first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: A sturdy table and a few tools would help first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay—where should I bring the table and which tools do you need?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll pass that along too and see who else can help out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep repeating the plan around the block and help gather a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad you reached out, Uli — let’s get the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I can help with the flyers and let folks know where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Uli — I’ll draft the flyer details and confirm the drop-off spot, and you can help spread the word. If you can, let’s touch base tomorrow and make sure we’re both set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up a few needed fixes around the block—nice to see folks pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. I’ll stop by and see what’s needed, then I can help where I’m useful.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Eli—last I heard they still need a hand with the gate and a few loose steps. I’ll point you to whoever’s coordinating when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’m just glad you made it. We still need to sort the boxes, label the tool bins, and make sure the pickup table’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll start on the boxes and help get the pickup table ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I still need to sort the donations and check what tools we’re short on. If you can help with either, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort the donations, and then I’ll help check the tools we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just the repair drive’s exact location and who’s dropping it off, so I can keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s at my place, and I can drop it off myself.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like a good chance to get everyone on the same page about the repair drive. Want me to help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please—could you share the basics and double-check the time and meeting spot before you send it out?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the time and meeting spot first, then share a quick summary of the repair drive basics.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered, but I’m here if you need me to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — could you help sort the donations when you get a minute? I’ll keep you posted on what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — just point me to the boxes and I’ll sort what I can. I may need a reminder on what’s most needed, but I’m on it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Ira — I appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you help sort the donated tools and label the boxes? That’d save us a lot of time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and label the boxes. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where the drop-off is first. I just want to make sure the logistics are clear before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — the drop-off is at the community center on Saturday morning, and I’ll send the exact timing tonight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me—just send the exact time tonight, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, great — I’m happy to spread the word about the repair drive. If you want, I can invite a few neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be wonderful, Quinn — thank you. Please invite a few neighbors, and I’ll keep track of what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll ask a few neighbors right away and let you know who can help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate, but I need to know the school pickup times first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, right — I’ll check the pickup times and get them to you. Thanks for helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren. Once you send them, I’ll line everything up around pickup and the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to drop off supplies.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll spread the word as best I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Nell — that helps a lot. I’ll post the details and keep everything moving smoothly.
